metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: CESLOE crystallizes in the hexagonal crystal system with space group P -6 2 c. Reported CIF formula moiety: (C126 H198 N27 Na3 Ni21 O180 Pr20)n,15(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Pr1 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr3 (Pr) has 8 O neighbors; Ni2 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr2 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Ni4 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr4 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Ni3 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni1 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr5 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr6 (Pr) has 8 O neighbors; Ni5 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr7 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Ni6 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni7 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni8 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr8 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr9 (Pr) has 8 O neighbors; Ni9 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr10 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Ni10 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni11 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni12 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr11 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr12 (Pr) has 8 O neighbors; Ni13 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr13 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Ni14 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr14 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Ni15 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr15 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr16 (Pr) has 8 O neighbors; Ni16 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr17 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Ni17 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni18 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr18 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr19 (Pr) has 8 O neighbors; Ni19 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr20 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Ni20 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni21 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 69 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.509-4.212 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 98.26-116.41°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C126H228N27Na3Pr20Ni21O195.
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
